name: tambor-browser-logo
description: tambor-y9d.7 — the Logo world (pure fold interpreter) written in squint, built into browser artifacts with squint and cherry, run under a strict CSP in headless chromium

scripts.build:squint: npx squint compile src && npx esbuild src/logo/main.mjs --bundle --format=iife --outfile=artifact-squint/bundle.js
scripts.build:cherry: npx cherry compile src && npx esbuild src/logo/main.mjs --bundle --format=iife --outfile=artifact-cherry/bundle.js
